name: OSS_CHARGE_PER_ADJUSTMENTS
description: This table contains data of charges per adjustments

columns.name: CHARGE_PERIOD_ADJ_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the charge period adjustment,primary key

columns.name: CHARGE_PERIOD_ADJ_PUID
columns.description: Public unique Identifier of the charge  period adjustment

columns.name: CHARGE_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Charge period identifier,parent key to oss_charge_periods

columns.name: CHARGE_ID
columns.description: Charge identifier,foreign key to oss_charges

columns.name: CHARGE_ADJUSTMENT_ID
columns.description: Charge identifier,foreign key to oss_charges

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the charge adjustment.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Sort order of adjusment for the charge period

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_ID
columns.description: Subscription Identifier,foreign key to oss_subscriptions

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: Product Identifier,foreign key to oss_products

columns.name: PRODUCT_ASSOCIATION_ID
columns.description: Product Association identifier,foreign key to oss_product_association

columns.name: CHARGE_PERIOD
columns.description: Charge period sequence number.

columns.name: NET_PRICE_BASIS
columns.description: Amount used for computing percentage adjustment when adjustment basis selected is Net price

columns.name: ADJ_PERIOD_FACTOR
columns.description: Multiplier used if adjustment is applied only for a portion of the charge period

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Adjustment amount computed for the charge period adjustment

columns.name: NET_PRICE
columns.description: Net price after applying current adjustment to the charge period

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_STEP_SEQ_NUM
columns.description: The Sequence Number assigned to the category. The adjustments get applied based on the value in this column followed by the sequence number of the adjustment.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Represents the category to which the adjustment is assigned. Valid values are from the lookup ORA_OSS_PRICE_ADJ_CATEGORY.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
